name: Understanding Public Policy Making Through Case-Studies
description: There are two parts to this course - the first part of the course provides the students with the conceptual models and frameworks to structure the ways to think about and explain processes of policymaking. In the second, real-world case studies drawn from different fields, like public health, direct benefit transfer, and domestic manufacturing in high technology areas, enable students to apply insights from theory to actual policy making.
